internal_collaboration.evidence_quote: Jon was joined by his seven-year-old daughter Ellie riding to the first four pubs, and different team members and supporters accompanied him for other parts of his challenge. The ride started at the Hall & Woodhouse Brewery in Blandford and took him to over 50 Hall & Woodhouse pubs including the Olive Branch (Wimborne), Ship Inn (Weymouth), Grasshopper (Parkstone), Old Granary (Wareham) and Lulworth Cove Inn before returning to the Brewery.
